title: 第五章 仪式（第三更求推荐票）
content_zh:
免费？免费的东西才是最贵的！周明瑞无声嘀咕，打算等下不管有什么附加服务，都坚定拒绝。
有本事你就占卜出我是穿越的！
想到这里，周明瑞跟在脸涂红黄油彩的女子身后，弯腰进了那低矮的帐篷。
帐篷内非常黑暗，只得少许光线渗入，隐约照出一张摆满纸牌的桌子。
头戴尖帽的女子一点不受影响，黑色长裙飘荡在水上般绕过桌子，坐到对面，点燃了蜡烛。
昏黄摇曳，帐篷内似明似暗，瞬间多了几分神秘的感觉。
周明瑞不动声色坐下，目光扫过桌上的塔罗牌，发现有自己熟悉的“魔术师”、“皇帝”、“倒吊人”和“节制”等主牌。
“罗塞尔同志难道真是‘前辈’……不知道是不是我大吃货帝国的老乡……”周明瑞嘴角微动，一阵恍惚。
他还没来得及看完桌上翻开的纸牌，号称“占卜很灵”的女子已伸手将所有的塔罗拢在一起，叠成一堆，推到了他的面前。
“你来洗牌、切牌。”这位马戏团的占卜师低哑说道。
“我来洗？”周明瑞下意识反问。
占卜师脸上红黄油彩蠕动，露出浅淡的笑容道：
“当然，每个人的命运只有自己才能占卜，我只是一个解读者。”
周明瑞当即警惕反问：
“解读不额外收费吧？”
作为键盘民俗学家，类似的伎俩我见得多了！
占卜师明显愣了一下，好一会儿才闷闷道：
“免费的。”
周明瑞放下心来，将左轮手枪往口袋里又塞了一点，接着坦然伸出双掌，熟练地洗牌、切牌。
“好了。”他将洗好的塔罗牌放在了桌子中央。

占卜师双手交握，认真看了一会纸牌，忽然开口道：
“不好意思，忘了问，你要占卜什么？”
当年追未遂初恋的时候，周明瑞也是研究过塔罗牌的，毫不犹豫道：
“过去，现在，和未来。”
这是塔罗牌里一种占卜牌阵，三张牌依次排开，分别象征过去、现在和未来。
占卜师先是点头，接着嘴角上翘，露出微笑道：
“那请你再洗一次牌，明白自己想询问什么，才能洗出真正有象征意义的牌。”
你刚才是在耍我啊……要不要这么小气，不就是我一直强调免费吗……周明瑞脸庞的肌肉抽动了一下，深吸口气，拿回塔罗，重新洗牌、切牌。
“这次没问题了吧？”他把切好的纸牌放置于桌上。
“没有了。”占卜师伸出手指，从顶端拿起一张牌，放在了周明瑞左手边，嗓音愈发地低哑，“这张象征过去。”
“这张象征现在。”占卜师将第二张牌放到周明瑞正前方。、
她又拿起第三张牌，置于周明瑞右手边：
“这张象征未来。”
“好了，你想先看哪张牌？”做完这一切，占卜师抬起脑袋，用灰蓝色的眼眸深深望向周明瑞。
“先看‘现在’吧。”周明瑞略作思考道。
占卜师缓缓点头，将位于正前方的纸牌翻了过来。
这张纸牌画着一位穿华丽衣物、戴绚烂头饰、肩上扛着手杖、杖头挂着行李、身后有小狗拉拽的年轻人，序号是“0”。
“愚者。”占卜师轻声念出了这张牌，灰蓝眼眸定定看着周明瑞。
愚者？塔罗的零号牌？开始？包含所有可能的开始？周明瑞连塔罗初级爱好者都算不上，只能根据印象，自我先做了一个粗浅的解读。
就在占卜师即将开口时，帐篷的布门突然被掀开，强烈的阳光照了进来，刺得背对那里的周明瑞都本能眯起了眼睛。

“你怎么又在假扮我！给人占卜是我的工作！”一道女声愤怒低吼，“快回去！你要
驯兽师？周明瑞适应了光线，看见门口是位同样戴尖帽、穿黑裙、涂红黄油彩的女子，只是个子更高，体型更瘦。
他面前坐着的那位女子连忙站了起来，怏怏道：
“不要介意，我只是喜欢这个，不得不说，有的时候，我的占卜和解读都挺准，真的……”
她边说边提起裙摆，从侧面绕过桌子，快步离开了帐篷。
“这位先生，需要我帮你解读吗？”真正的占卜师看向周明瑞，微笑问道。
周明瑞动了动嘴角，诚恳反问：
“免费吗？”
“……不。”真正的占卜师回答道。
“那算了。”周明瑞将手掌插回口袋，按住左轮和纸币，弯腰穿出了帐篷。
这真是的，竟然找了个驯兽师做塔罗占卜！
不想做占卜家的驯兽师不是好小丑？
周明瑞很快将这件事情抛到了脑后，在“莴苣和肉类”市场花7便士买了1磅不那么好的羔羊肉，又买了嫩豌豆、卷心菜、洋葱、土豆等物品，加上之前的面包，一共用了25铜便士，也就是2苏勒1便士。
“钱还真不禁花啊，可怜的班森……”周明瑞不仅没了带出门的两张纸币，还搭上了原本裤袋里的一枚便士。
他随口这么感叹了一句，不再多想，急匆匆返回了家里。
有了主食，就能进行转运仪式了！
…………
等到二楼租客们纷纷离开，周明瑞没急着进行仪式，而是先将“福生玄黄仙尊”等词语翻译成了古弗萨克文和鲁恩文，打算原本咒语如果没能起效，那就隔天换本地语言再试一次！
毕竟得考虑两界不同，入乡随俗的问题。
至于翻译成古代祈祷、祭祀专用的赫密斯文，周明瑞因为词汇量不够，难以完成。

做完这一切，他才从纸袋里抽出四条黑麦面包，一根置于原本放煤炭炉子的角落，一根在穿衣镜的底部内侧，一根在橱柜顶部靠两面墙交汇的地方，一根在书桌右边堆放杂物之处。
深吸口气，周明瑞来到房间中央，先平静了几分钟，接着才凝重迈步，逆时针走正方形。
第一步迈出，他低声诵念道：
“福生玄黄仙尊。”
第二步，他诚恳默念：
“福生玄黄天君。”
第三步，周明瑞屏气凝息低语：
“福生玄黄上帝。”
第四步，他吐出浊气，用心默念道：
“福生玄黄天尊。”
走完归位，周明瑞闭上眼睛，原地等待着结果，心里有期待，有不安，有希冀，有惶恐。
能回去吗？
会有效果吗？
会不会出现什么意外情况？
眼前的黑暗染着光明带来的深红，周明瑞脑海里的念头纷纷涌涌，难以平息。
就在这时，他突然感觉四周的空气似乎停止了流动，变得粘稠而诡异。
紧跟着，他的耳畔响起了时而细密，时而尖锐，时而虚幻，时而诱人，时而狂躁，时而疯癫的低语。
明明听不懂这呢喃声在说些什么，周明瑞还是忍不住去倾听，去分辨。
他的头再次疼痛，剧烈得像是插进了一根钢钎。
周明瑞只觉脑袋快要爆开，思绪都染上了迷幻的色彩。

他知道不对，竭力想睁开眼睛，可却怎么都完成不了这个简单的动作。
整个人愈发紧绷，随时都可能断掉，周明瑞莫名冒出了一个自嘲的念头：
“不作死就不会死……”
他再也无法承受，脑海里那根弦即将崩断时，无数嗓音嘈杂交叠的呢喃声退去了，周围变得非常安静，氛围颇为飘忽。
不仅仅氛围，周明瑞觉得自己的身体也同样的飘忽。
他再次尝试睁眼，这一次非常轻松。
弥漫的灰雾映入他的眼眸，朦胧、模糊、无边无际。
“这是什么情况？”周明瑞愕然四望，继而低头，发现自己漂浮在一片无垠灰雾的边缘。
灰雾如水流淌，点缀着一颗颗深红色的“星辰”，它们有的很大，有的渺小，有的藏于深处，有的浮在表面。
看着这全息影像般的场景，周明瑞半是迷惑半是探索地伸出右手，试图触摸右侧浮于表面的一颗深红“星辰”，寻找离开的办法。
当他手指刚触及那颗星辰的表面，忽然有水纹从他身上涌出，激得“深红”爆发，像是一团梦幻的焰火。
周明瑞吓了一跳，右手慌乱收回，不小心又碰到了另一颗“深红”。
于是，这“星辰”也跟着大放光明。
于是，周明瑞觉得脑袋发空，精神涣散。
…………
鲁恩王国首都贝克兰德，皇后区，一栋豪华的别墅内。
奥黛丽.霍尔坐在梳妆台前，摩挲着桌上花纹古老、表面有裂的铜镜。
“魔镜魔镜快苏醒……”
“我以霍尔家族之名，命令你苏醒！”
她换了一种又一种说辞，但镜子都毫无反应。

过了十几分钟，她终于选择放弃，委屈抿嘴，小声嘟囔道：
“爸爸果然在欺骗我，每次都给我讲这面镜子是古代所罗门帝国黑皇帝的珍宝，是非凡物品……”
她话音未落，摆放于桌面的铜镜突然绽放深红光芒，一下将她笼罩。
…………
苏尼亚海上，一艘明显落后于时代的三桅帆船正穿行于暴风雨里。
阿尔杰.威尔逊站在甲板上，身体随着颠簸而起伏，轻松保持着平衡。
他身穿绣有闪电花纹的长袍，手中托着一个造型古怪的玻璃瓶，里面时而翻滚气泡，时而霜聚成雪，时而有风刮出痕迹。
“还差鬼鲨的血……”阿尔杰低语道。
就在这时，那玻璃瓶与他的手掌间有深红爆发，刹那便淹没了周围。
…………
一片灰白的迷雾之上，奥黛丽.霍尔恢复了视线，又惊恐又迷茫地左右打量起来，看见斜对面头部模糊、身影朦胧的男子也是差不多的动作。
紧跟着，他们几乎同时发现不远处还站着一位周身笼罩着灰白雾气的神秘人。
“神秘人”周明瑞同样目瞪口呆。
“阁下，这是哪里？”
“您想做什么？”
奥黛丽和阿尔杰先是一怔，陷入沉默，旋即不约而同地开口。
PS：1/7，补上一章，求推荐票~
content_en:
free? Free things are the most expensive! Zhou Mingrui muttered silently, planning to refuse any additional services later.
If you have the ability, you can divine that I have traveled through time!
Thinking of this, Zhou Mingrui followed the woman with red butter paint on her face and bent down into the low tent.
It was very dark inside the tent, with only a little light seeping in, vaguely illuminating a table filled with cards.
The woman wearing a pointed hat was not affected at all. Her black dress floated around the table, sat on the opposite side, and lit a candle.
The dusk was swaying, and the tent seemed bright and dark. It instantly felt a bit more mysterious.
Zhou Mingrui sat down calmly, scanning the tarot cards on the table and found that he was familiar with the main cards such as "Magician", "Emperor", "Hanged Man" and "Temperance".
"Is Comrade Russell really a 'senior'... I wonder if he is a fellow member of my big foodie empire..." The corner of Zhou Mingrui's mouth moved slightly, and he was in a trance.
Before he could read the cards on the table, the woman who was said to be "very good at divination" had reached out and gathered all the tarots together, stacked them into a pile, and pushed them in front of him.
"You shuffle and cut the cards," the circus fortune teller said in a low voice.
"Shall I wash it?" Zhou Mingrui asked subconsciously.
The red and yellow color on the diviner's face squirmed, and he showed a faint smile and said:
"Of course, only you can divine everyone's destiny. I am just an interpreter."
Zhou Mingrui immediately asked warily:
“There’s no extra charge for interpretation, right?”
As a keyboard folklorist, I’ve seen similar tricks a lot!
The fortune teller was obviously stunned for a moment, and then said dullly for a while:
"It's free."
Zhou Mingrui felt relieved, stuffed the revolver a little more into his pocket, then calmly stretched out his palms, shuffling and cutting the cards skillfully.
"Okay." He placed the shuffled tarot cards in the center of the table.
The fortune teller clasped his hands together, looked at the cards carefully for a while, and then suddenly said:
"Sorry, I forgot to ask, what do you want to divine?"
When he was chasing his first love, Zhou Mingrui also studied tarot cards and said without hesitation:
"Past, present, and future."
This is a divination card array in Tarot. Three cards are arranged in sequence, symbolizing the past, present and future respectively.
The fortune teller nodded first, then raised the corners of his mouth and smiled:
"Then please shuffle the cards again and understand what you want to ask, so that you can shuffle the cards with truly symbolic meaning."
You were playing tricks on me just now... Are you so stingy? I keep emphasizing that it's free... The muscles on Zhou Mingrui's face twitched. He took a deep breath, took the Tarot back, shuffled and cut the cards again.
"Is it okay this time?" He placed the cut cards on the table.
"No more." The fortune teller stretched out his fingers, picked up a card from the top, and placed it on Zhou Mingrui's left hand. His voice became increasingly hoarse, "This card symbolizes the past."
"This card symbolizes the present." The fortune teller placed the second card directly in front of Zhou Mingrui. ,
She picked up the third card and placed it on Zhou Mingrui's right hand:
"This one symbolizes the future."
"Okay, which card do you want to see first?" After doing all this, the fortune teller raised his head and looked deeply at Zhou Mingrui with his gray-blue eyes.
"Let's look at 'now' first." Zhou Mingrui thought briefly.
The fortune teller nodded slowly and turned over the cards in front of him.
This card depicts a young man wearing gorgeous clothes and a gorgeous headdress, carrying a cane on his shoulder, luggage hanging on the head of the cane, and a dog pulling behind him. The serial number is "0".
"The Fool." The fortune teller read out the card softly, looking at Zhou Mingrui with his gray-blue eyes.
Fool? Tarot card number zero? start? Include all possible starts? Zhou Mingrui was not even a beginner Tarot enthusiast, so he could only make a rough interpretation based on his impressions.
Just when the fortune teller was about to speak, the cloth door of the tent suddenlySuddenly it was opened, and strong sunlight shone in, so harsh that Zhou Mingrui, who had his back turned, instinctively squinted his eyes.
"Why are you pretending to be me again! It's my job to tell people divination!" A female voice roared angrily, "Go back quickly! You want to
Tamer? Zhou Mingrui adapted to the light and saw a woman at the door who also wore a pointed hat, black skirt, and red paint. She was just taller and thinner.
The woman sitting in front of him quickly stood up and said sadly:
"Don't mind, I just like this. I have to say that sometimes, my divination and interpretation are quite accurate, really..."
As she spoke, she lifted up her skirt, walked around the table from the side, and quickly left the tent.
"Sir, do you need me to help you interpret it? "The real fortune teller looked at Zhou Mingrui and asked with a smile.
Zhou Mingrui moved the corners of his mouth and asked sincerely:
"Free? "
"……No. ” replied the true diviner.
"Forget it. "Zhou Mingrui put his palms back into his pockets, held down the revolver and banknotes, and bent down to walk out of the tent.
It’s true, I actually found an animal trainer to do tarot divination!
Wouldn't an animal trainer who doesn't want to be a fortune teller be a good clown?
Zhou Mingrui quickly put the matter behind him and bought 1 pound of not-so-good lamb at the "Lettuce and Meat" market for 7 pence. He also bought young peas, cabbage, onions, potatoes and other items, plus the previous bread, for a total of 25 copper pence, which was 2 soles and 1 penny.
"You can't help but spend money, poor Benson..." Zhou Mingrui not only lost the two banknotes he took out, but also lost a penny in his trouser pocket.
He sighed casually, no longer thought about it, and hurried back home.
With the staple food, you can perform the transfer ceremony!
…………
When the tenants on the second floor left one after another, Zhou Mingrui was not in a hurry to perform the ceremony. Instead, he first translated the words "Fusheng Xuanhuang Immortal Lord" into ancient Fusac and Rune script. He planned that if the original spell did not work, he would try again in the local language the next day!
After all, we have to consider the issue of two worlds being different and doing as the Romans do.
As for the translation into the Hermes text used for ancient prayers and sacrifices, Zhou Mingrui had difficulty completing it because of his insufficient vocabulary.
After doing all this, he took out four loaves of rye bread from the paper bag. One loaf was placed in the corner where the coal stove was originally placed, one was on the inside of the bottom of the dressing mirror, one was on the top of the cabinet where the two walls met, and one was on the right side of the desk where the sundries were piled.
Taking a deep breath, Zhou Mingrui came to the center of the room. He calmed down for a few minutes before taking serious steps and walking in a square counterclockwise direction.
Taking the first step, he chanted in a low voice:
"Fusheng Xuanhuang Immortal Lord. "
In the second step, he sincerely recited:
"Fusheng Xuanhuang Tianjun. "
In the third step, Zhou Mingrui held his breath and whispered:
“The God of Blessings and Prosperity Xuanhuang. "
In the fourth step, he exhaled his turbid breath and said silently:
"Fusheng Xuanhuang Tianzun. "
After returning to his place after walking, Zhou Mingrui closed his eyes and waited for the result. He was filled with expectations, uneasiness, hope, and fear.
Can you go back?
Will it be effective?
Will there be any unexpected situations?
The darkness in front of him was stained with the crimson brought by the light, and thoughts in Zhou Mingrui's mind surged and it was difficult to calm down.
At this moment, he suddenly felt that the air around him seemed to have stopped flowing and became thick and strange.
Immediately afterwards, there were whispers in his ears that were sometimes thin, sometimes sharp, sometimes illusory, sometimes seductive, sometimes manic, and sometimes crazy.
Although he clearly didn't understand what the whispering was saying, Zhou Mingrui couldn't help but listen and distinguish.
His head hurt again, as intensely as if a steel drill had been inserted into it.
Zhou Mingrui felt that his head was about to explode, and his thoughts were tinged with psychedelic colors.
He knew something was wrong and tried his best to open his eyes, but he couldn't complete this simple action.
My whole body is getting tighter and tighter, it could happen at any timeAfter disconnecting, Zhou Mingrui had a self-deprecating thought inexplicably:
"If you don't seek death, you won't die..."
He could no longer bear it. When the string in his mind was about to break, the noisy and overlapping murmurs of countless voices receded, and the surroundings became very quiet and the atmosphere was quite erratic.
Not only the atmosphere, Zhou Mingrui felt that his body was equally erratic.
He tried to open his eyes again, this time with ease.
The diffuse gray fog reflected in his eyes, hazy, blurry and boundless.
"What is going on?" Zhou Mingrui looked around in shock, then lowered his head and found himself floating on the edge of an endless gray fog.
The gray mist flows like water, dotted with dark red "stars". Some of them are large, some are small, some are hidden in the depths, and some are floating on the surface.
Looking at this holographic image-like scene, Zhou Mingrui stretched out his right hand half in confusion and half exploration, trying to touch a dark red "star" floating on the surface on the right side, looking for a way to leave.
When his fingers just touched the surface of the star, water ripples suddenly poured out from his body, causing "deep red" to explode, like a dreamy firework.
Zhou Mingrui was startled, and he retracted his right hand in a panic, accidentally touching another "Crimson".
As a result, the "star" also shined brightly.
As a result, Zhou Mingrui felt empty-headed and distracted.

In Backlund, the capital of Loen Kingdom, in the Queens District, inside a luxurious villa.
Audrey Hall sat in front of the dressing table, stroking the bronze mirror with ancient patterns and cracks on the surface.
"Mirror, Mirror, wake up soon..."
"In the name of the Hall family, I order you to wake up!"
She tried one explanation after another, but the mirror showed no reaction.
After more than ten minutes, she finally chose to give up, pursed her lips in frustration, and muttered in a low voice:
"Dad is really lying to me. He always tells me that this mirror is the treasure of the Black Emperor of the ancient Solomon Empire and is an extraordinary item..."
Before she finished speaking, the bronze mirror placed on the table suddenly burst into crimson light, covering her.
…………
On the Sunian Sea, a three-masted sailboat that was obviously behind the times was sailing through the storm.
Alger Wilson stood on the deck, his body undulating with the bumps and maintaining balance easily.
He was wearing a robe embroidered with lightning patterns, and he was holding a strange-shaped glass bottle in his hand. Bubbles sometimes rolled inside, sometimes frost gathered into snow, and sometimes there were traces of wind blowing.
"Still missing the ghost shark's blood..." Alger whispered.
At this moment, deep red burst out between the glass bottle and his palm, flooding the surrounding area in an instant.
…………
Atop the gray fog, Audrey Hall regained her sight and looked around in horror and confusion. She saw a man with a blurred head and a hazy figure diagonally across from her making similar movements.
Immediately afterwards, they almost simultaneously discovered a mysterious man covered in gray-white mist standing not far away.
"Mysterious Man" Zhou Mingrui was also stunned.
"Sir, where is this?"
"What do you want to do?"
Audrey and Alger were startled for a moment and fell into silence, then spoke in unison.
PS: 1/7, add another chapter, please vote for recommendation~
